_about: 2-Methoxyethanol (1) + Cyclohexane (2): isobaric T-x-y at 100.0 kPa. source.citation: B. Marrufo, S. Loras, M. Sanchotello, Isobaric Vapor-Liquid Equilibria for Binary and Ternary Mixtures with Cyclohexane, Cyclohexene, and 2-Methoxyethanol at 100 kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 55 (2010) 62-68
